Each contrast is tested on the per-trial paired difference d = A - B (pairs matched on session x trial_idx; in a vs-zero test d is the value itself), NaN dropped, with a linear mixed model d ~ 1 + (1 | session) (session ids are unique across the two patients), fitted by REML in statsmodels MixedLM (optimizers lbfgs, powell and cg; of the fits that converge with a finite intercept SE and log-likelihood, the one with the largest log-likelihood is kept): the fixed intercept is the mean difference and the session random intercept accounts for trials within a session being correlated. Per-patient rows fit the same model to that patient's trials (4 and 5 sessions). Its Wald p is p_used for every contrast; Shapiro-Wilk on the residuals and the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p are reported in the Source Data only. Stars *** / ** / * / ns at 0.001 / 0.01 / 0.05 on p_used. Boxes, lines and in-figure numbers show medians, descriptively.

the bracket stars are drawn from p_fdr_bh = Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over the panel's three contrasts, computed from p_used with statsmodels multipletests(method='fdr_bh') (family F15-asymmetry of results_statistics_source_data.csv); *** / ** / * / ns at 0.001 / 0.01 / 0.05 on p_fdr_bh (stats column star_drawn); the stats column star is the uncorrected star of p_used.
